title: AiSuggestion
description: A natural-language pricing instruction, the AI's proposed change (a JSON Patch against one specific config document of any kind — region config, price list, catalog book, routing rules, ...), and its full review trail. Nothing here ever touches a live config by itself — see design principle: 'AI suggests, interprets instructions, and explains — it never silently does arithmetic.' Approving a suggestion (applySuggestion) produces a DRAFT version that a human still has to publish (four-eyes). `targetKind`/`targetKey` identify the document; `region`/`salesOrg` remain for region-config suggestions written before v2 and are derived from targetKey when absent.

targetKey.description: The document key as ConfigStore stringifies it: region::salesOrg, supplier, ood::salesOrg, customerId, book id, or "*".

salesOrg.description: Legacy (pre-v2) target for region-config suggestions; equivalent to targetKind region-config + targetKey region::salesOrg.

baseVersion.description: The document version this patch is diffed against.

instruction.description: The natural-language instruction as given by the user, verbatim.

proposedPatch.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations against the target document.

resultingVersion.description: Set once status=APPLIED — the DRAFT version the approval produced.
